title: Neighbor Asks Man to Lower His Music, Pulls Out Gun Instead
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 7, 2023, police responded to a hotel after receiving a report of an individual with a firearm in La Crosse, WI. The caller stated that her husband had confronted a man about loud music, and in response, the man allegedly pointed a gun at him and made threats. Upon arrival, officers found the suspect, who refused to cooperate. Concerned for the victim's safety and the suspect's intentions while armed, police took necessary action.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
